methods.description: Rename one whole in equalparts and subtract; interpret missing part or correct failure to rename.
Keep remaining wholes and rename just one whole before removing a proper fraction.
Remove matching complete wholes before finding the fractional gap to a whole.
Use the number of parts in one whole and known remaining parts to find the removed numerator; check the two parts makeone.
Group equalparts to write the remainder as an equivalent simpler fraction.
